# Redirect host (www)

Redirect to another host, keeping the path and query — add or remove www, or send aliases to one domain.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `redirectHost` |
| **Category** | Transform |
| **Requires** | Goma Gateway 1.2.0 or newer |

:::warning Gateway version
A route using this middleware fails to load on a gateway older than **1.2.0**. Miabi does not read the running gateway's version, so nothing stops you saving it — the route is what reports the problem.
:::

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `www` | one of `add`, `remove` | no | — | add: example.com → www.example.com. remove: www.example.com → example.com. |
| `host` | text | no | — | Instead of www: send every other host on the route here. Example: `example.com`. |
| `permanent` | true/false | no | — | Use 301 instead of 302. |
